english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for the skin or outer layer of a fruit or vegetable.
Use 皮 as the everyday general noun when context makes clear whether the referent is body skin, fruit peel, or an animal hide or pelt.

examples.english: This apple's peel is very thin, so you don't need to peel it.
examples.traditional: 呢個蘋果嘅皮好薄，唔使削。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 ge3 pei4 hou2 bok6 m4 sai2 soek3

examples.english: The skin of this orange is easy to peel.
